collapse_regions: dense support + shrinkage=0 -> SACPS covariance equals raw covariance removal control
evidence_boundary: internal deterministic mechanics only; no empirical or deployment claim
external_prior_art_examples: decision-focused learning / predict-then-optimize literature evaluates predictors by downstream regret
decision-focused covariance estimation for minimum-variance portfolios directly links covariance estimates to downstream decision quality
mean-variance predict-and-optimize literature places covariance inside downstream risk-aware decision objectives
mechanism_removing_comparator: same DLEW shell with raw sample covariance substituted for SACPS covariance

nearest_existing_products.V2P030_PCFDLW: changes which candidate models are admissible through closure/fidelity certification; SACDLW keeps the candidate set and changes the action/regret geometry
nearest_existing_products.V2P041_CDTDLEW: changes DLEW selection over a channel-tipping ambiguity set; SACDLW changes within-regime finite-action risk geometry from covariance support
nearest_existing_products.V2P049_SACAPL: also injects SACPS covariance into a risk objective, but learns a constrained continuous portfolio policy; SACDLW does not learn a policy and instead changes retrospective finite-action model selection/regret inside DLEW

new_failure_mode: DLEW can select a prediction model and finite action sequence using a risk geometry contaminated by finite-sample covariance edges that contradict declared dependency support.
non_additive_interaction: SACPS covariance enters DLEW before argmax action selection and therefore changes the induced action path, oracle comparison, training model ranking, and validation decision regret rather than appending a covariance report.
sensitivity_boundary: benefit is not universal across random shells; strong nuisance cells are favorable on average but contain losing seeds, so candidate must expose its working/failure region rather than claim dominance
working_region: declared support is correct, a small separate risk-estimation sample contains strong unsupported covariance nuisance, and risk aversion makes finite-action DLEW decisions sensitive to that nuisance
